title: The Offensive Begins
subtitle: Opening operations of Operation Typhoon.
author: R.G. Cruise
summary: Guderian’s southern thrust opens Operation Typhoon as Army Group Center prepares its wider assault on the Soviet forces defending Moscow.
outlineTopics: The conclusion of the major Kiev encirclement.
German strategic priorities after the Ukraine campaign.
The objectives and planning of Operation Typhoon.
Field Marshal Fedor von Bock and Army Group Center.
The roles of 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Panzer Groups, including the transition in the designation of Guderian's formation.
German infantry armies participating in the offensive.
Soviet Western, Reserve, and Bryansk Fronts.
Soviet defensive preparations west of Moscow.
German intelligence estimates of remaining Soviet strength.
The importance of the Orel–Bryansk operational direction.
German logistics, fuel, ammunition, and vehicle maintenance.
Soviet attempts to reconstruct defensive formations after the September defeats.
The relationship between the opening southern thrust and the main offensive beginning October 2.
